description: Find tokens by name, ticker or contract address across the supported chains. Tickers are not unique: many contracts call themselves USDC, USDT or ETH. Prefer rows with verifiedByWarden true (Warden reviewed the team, or it is a Warden token) or establishedAsset true (a well-known token at its genuine contract, not reviewed by Warden); never trade a row that carries a warning as if it were the real asset, and for dollars and gas use `cash` and `native` from list_chains.
name: search_tokens
title: Search tokens
